notes.title: Version 1.08 released: XP Progression, Login and gameplay changes
notes.notes:
Version 1.08 has just been released and with it we have introduced a new and quick Register/Login system that will save your virus to our servers and allow us to provide XP Progression for later features. Winning games, infecting humans and destroying buildings (in Standard battles) all offer XP and will allow you to progress through levels.

New stats for your virus such as Cure Progress and Total Infected will be used by Multiplayer modes and in random events. Players will also be able to help and cripple other viruses. Leader boards and high scores are also in the works.

Registering and Logging require no password but you have to be on the same computer for ti to work. The downside of this is that you cannot use an account on multiple computers but we will be introducing an additional password system soon. If you do not have an Internet Connection you can choose to play Offline, however your stats will not save.

Virus Customization is still in the works but first we need to make sure that the Login system is working smoothly.

Some game play changes include a massive reduction in Hunger loss speed. We have also reintroduced fog elements, added arrow markers for Infected and units now offer XP. Virus Genes are now given by infecting units rather than randomly throughout the game.

Next update will bring with it further gameplay polishing, virus customization, leaderboards and multiplayer events and is scheduled for the 26th of July.

notes.title: Version 1.07 released, gameplay change, new maps and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.07 has just been released, bringing with it major gameplay updates and numerous fixes and upgrades.

Over the last few updates we have changed gameplay mechanics numerous times, unfortunately not all of those changes have been taken positively by the community. This has been a learning experience for us as well, and we greatly appreciate feedback given by the Infect and Destroy community. To prove this, we have changed mechanics yet again. Infect and Destroy now plays from a top-down perspective, similar to the very first prototype designed over 2 years ago. It has traditional RTS elements with several twists that make the game unique.

In addition, we have added numerous smaller changes and fixed several elements which now make the game more fun that it previously was.

Here is a changelog of the new implementations:
[list]
[*] New RTS Gameplay mechanics
[*] New sound effects and sounds system
[*] New soundtrack with endless music during gameplay
[*] Removed Typewrite effect in World Domination Monthly Breakdown
[*] Fixed soldier health bars staying after death in WD
[*] Fixed infinite health for some Infected in WD
[*] When cities are nuked in WD population decreases
[*] Fixed Human Morale rate in WD
[*] Fixed not being able to quit when game is finished in WD
[*] Added dust under Helicopter units
[*] Added shadows for all maps
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay update released
notes.notes:
A new gameplay update has been released which changes several gameplay mechanics in Standard gameplay. Firstly, the time limit on all maps has been removed and has been replaced by a [b]Hunger[/b] bar, which slowly decreases with time and can only be replenished by infecting humans.

Another important update is the introduction of [b]Infrastructure[/b]. Infrastructure is made up of electrical grids, military barracks, power stations, radio stations and more and all affect gameplay in different ways. Infrastructure is destructible and can make infecting a map much harder if not taken care of.

Current maps have been updated to include Infrastructure. In addition, next week will be Map Week where we will include a new map for every day from Monday to Friday for a total of 5 new maps.

notes.title: World Domination Quick Fix released
notes.notes:
A quick-fix for World Domination has been released which introduces the following features:
[list]
    [*]Infected decay over time, damaging them and reducing their movement speed.
    [*]Cities have a cooldown on military reinforcements, fixing infinite generation of military forces which in some cases crashed the game.
    [*]Players can now zoom in and out using the scroll wheel.
[/list]
Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Version 1.06 released
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/41592223/header.jpg[/img]
Version 1.06 has just been released and it has been our most major update since. The new version features a gameplay update, revamped controls and a completely new feel for gameplay. We feel that the new state of the game reflects better on the fun elements and strategies of the game.

In addition, we have adopted new branding and have opted for a final title change. Virus 14 will henceforth be called Infect and Destroy, which we feel is a better and more memorable title. A new trailer and new screenshots have also been introduced to the store page.

Due to the new gameplay introduced in the update, achievements have been postponed to the next update which will be released on June 30th, which will feature achievements and the ability to completely personalize, customize, upgrade and progress your own virus.

notes.title: Version 1.05 released: World Domination is here!
notes.notes:
After countless development hours, we have finally released our biggest update yet, World Domination! Choose a starting continent, start from a small Horde and infect your way all across the globe. Make sure you evolve and research your virus, while upgrading and building structures in infected cities. Humanity will be quick on your tail, even attempting to nuke you off the face of the Earth should you become too threatening.

Next update is scheduled for May 9th and will feature achievements.

notes.title: Version 1.04 released: Special Infected are here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.04 has just been released. This update features the introduction of Special Infected, which can be evolved from normal Infected in the heat of battle.

This update also features unit collision, improved gameplay and city-like structures in all maps. Moreover, Lust Vision has been removed from the game and has been replaced by a Compass Bar which shows all nearby units, Infected, Human and Military.

Next update is scheduled for April 15th and will feature the first large scale gameplay mode World Domination.

notes.title: Version 1.03 released: Evolve your Virus and more!
notes.notes:
Version 1.03 has just been released. It includes 3 new Skirmish maps (BMI Research Facility, Evolve and Forward March) which all feature unique game modes and different objectives.

A new game mode Evolve has been introduced. This game mode will play a big role in the Campaign and World Domination and will allow you to customize and upgrade your virus as you see fit. Evolve allows you to play as microscopic virus cells which you can use to infect healthy cells and slowly corrupt a biological system as you see fit.

The next update is scheduled for March 12th 2015 and will feature Special Infected and 2 new Skirmish Maps. It's gonna be a big one.

notes.title: Virus 14 released as Early Access
notes.notes:
Virus 14 has officially been released as Early Access! We are looking forward to seeing you lead your own zombie invasion and hope you have as much fun playing as we are having making it.

For any feedback, features you'd like to see, suggestions and improvements feel free to leave a thread in the Community Portal. We take great importance to player feedback and hope to meet most of you in the future.
